id: Jay and Silent Bob Strike Back (2001)
title: Jay and Silent Bob Strike Back
tagline: Road trip to Hollywood, snacks for the whole way.
about: Two slackers from New Jersey head to Hollywood to stop a movie being made about them.
cue: Serve the banana splits when Suzanne the orangutan makes her escape.

    StartersHitchhiker's jalapeño cheese toastiesSourdough toasties with cheddar, pickled jalapeño and tomato relishHow to make it50g butter, softened1 clove garlic150g cheddar, grated100g pepper jack or tasty cheese, grated3 tbsp pickled jalapenos8 slices of sourdough150g tomato relish1 pinch smoked paprikaMix the butter with crushed garlic. Grate the cheddar and the pepper jack or tasty cheese and drain and chop the jalapenos.Fill the sourdough with the grated cheddar and pepper jack and the jalapenos and spread garlic butter on the outsides.Cook in a pan over medium heat, pressing down, until golden and melting.Cut into fingers and serve with tomato relish stirred with a pinch of smoked paprika.Craft service grilled fruit with chilli limeCharred pineapple, rockmelon and watermelon with chilli and limeHow to make it1/2 pineapple1/4 rockmelon300g watermelon wedge1 tsp salt1 tsp chilli powder2 limes200g Greek yoghurt2 tbsp honey1 handful mint leavesCut the pineapple, rockmelon and watermelon into thick spears.Heat a grill pan or barbecue very hot and char the pineapple and rockmelon, leaving the watermelon raw.Mix the salt, chilli powder and zest of a lime. Stir the yoghurt with honey, lime juice and chopped mint.Arrange the fruit, sprinkle with chilli lime salt and serve with the dip.Jersey smoked ham and cheese slidersHome turf in New Jersey before the road tripHow to make itAs written, serves 4Thick smoked ham slices fried until caramelised and curled, stacked on toasted slider buns with melted American cheese, yellow mustard and pickles.Cut 400g thick smoked ham into 8 slices about 5mm thick and nick the edges.Fry in a little butter over medium heat for 2 minutes a side until caramelised.Lay a slice of American cheese on each, add a splash of water and cover for 30 seconds to melt.Toast 8 slider buns cut side down in the pan.Spread with yellow mustard, add the ham and cheese and top with sliced pickles.Jersey pork roll, egg and cheeseSnootchie bootchies. Mix the mayonnaise with tomato sauce.Smash the balls flat on a smoking griddle, season and cook, then flip, add cheese and cook a minute more.Stack 2 patties per toasted bun with pickles and sauce, then wrap in paper.Studio commissary chicken clubLunch on the Hollywood studio lotHow to make itAs written, serves 4Triple-decker toasted sandwiches of roast chicken, crisp bacon, avocado, tomato and cos with garlic mayo, cut into quarters and served with salted crisps.Grill 8 bacon rashers until crisp.Shred 500g roast chicken.Toast 12 slices of white bread.Mix 100g mayo with 1 crushed garlic clove.For each sandwich, spread 3 slices with mayo, layer chicken, avocado and cos on the first, bacon and tomato on the second, and top with the third.Pin with 4 toothpicks, cut into quarters and serve with 150g salted crisps.SweetsOrangutan banana splitsBanana with vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream, chocolate sauceHow to make it4 bananas400ml vanilla ice cream400ml chocolate ice cream400ml strawberry ice cream100g dark chocolate100ml thickened cream, for the fudge200ml thickened cream, whipped, for the topping50g peanuts, chopped4 maraschino cherriesSplit the bananas lengthways into 4 dishes.Add a scoop each of vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream.Melt the chocolate with the cream for the fudge and pour over.Top with the whipped cream for the topping, chopped peanuts and a cherry.DrinksConvenience store raspberry slushiesIcy raspberry and lemon slush, served in big cupsHow to make it200ml raspberry cordial600g ice200ml cold water1 lemonBlend the cordial, ice, water and lemon juice until smooth and slushy.Pour into 4 big cups and serve straight away with straws.Birch beerSilent Bob's order.
